name: Takeba Yukari
source:
Yukari is a former member of SEES and currently a university student, model and one of the main actors for the children's show Phoenix Ranger Featherman Victory. Yukari is cheerful and strong-willed, but tends to drive herself beyond her limits. Though she is known for her major mood swings, occasional displays of angst and emotional outbursts, Yukari is actually friendly and caring towards her peers, especially towards [url=/c51883]Fuuka[/url], and later, [url=/c51882]Mitsuru[/url]. In Ultimax, she becomes a reserve member of the Shadow Operatives.

Yukari also has phasmophobia, the fear of ghosts and is easily spooked, which Junpei, [url=/c52188]Akihiko[/url] and Ryoji often took advantage of by intentionally spooking her or telling her ghost stories to agitate her. Yukari's phasmophobia is also symbolic of her fear of death. Yukari has an extreme fear of death and the thought of non-existence sends chills down her spine.

[Edited from [url=http://megamitensei.wikia.com/wiki/Yukari_Takeba]Megami Tensei Wiki[/url]]

Her persona is [Url=https://megamitensei.fandom.com/wiki/Io_(Persona)]Io[/url], king of the gods in Greek mythology. She's the priestess of [Url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hera]Hera[/url] and the wife of [Url=https://megamitensei.fandom.com/wiki/Zeus]Zeus[/url].
